en.title: A rhythm action game with an unexpected “return trip”!? “DYU/TAN” made me realize the joy of looking back on my own footsteps and resonating with them.
en.summary: ``DYU/TAN'', which I tried out at the indie game exhibition event ``DREAMSCAPE #5'', is a work that combines auto-run jump action and a rhythm game. A feature of this work is that there is not only an ``outward path'' through the stages, but also a ``return path'' to return the way you came. Let me introduce you to a unique playing experience that "resonates" with the traces left by your past self.

en.title: Capcom released its latest financial report data, and new games such as "The Existence of Knowledge" performed well
en.summary: Capcom recently announced its consolidated performance report for the first half of fiscal year 2026. In the six months ending September 30, 2026, Capcom’s net sales were 120.887 billion yen, a year-on-year increase of 49.0%. Operating profit was 60.769 billion yen, a year-on-year increase of 54.5%. ja.title: 「Red Desert: Enhanced Edition」が 2026 Golden Joystick Awards の「Ultimate Game of the Year」にノミネートされました

en.title: "Red Desert: Enhanced Edition" was nominated for the "Ultimate Game of the Year" at the 2026 Golden Joystick Awards
en.summary: Pearl Abyss announced today that its open-world action-adventure game "Red Desert: Enhanced Edition" has been nominated for the "Ultimate Game of the Year" at the 2026 Golden Joystick Awards. The organizers of the Golden Joystick Awards announced on October 26 that "Red Desert: Enhanced Edition" was shortlisted for the "Ultimate Game of the Year". This award is one of the most important awards of the Golden Joystick Awards. Previously, the game had received two nominations for "PC Game of the Year" and "Best Soundtrack", and has received a total of three nominations for this year's Golden Joystick Awards. The Golden Joystick Award was founded in 1983 and is one of the oldest video game awards in the world. This year marks the 44th edition. Candidates for each award are selected by a jury composed of gaming media and industry experts.

en.title: ``Emiru'' is an app that helps you get used to daily life with paintings by continuously showing ``paintings'' on TV for free.
en.summary: The app ``Emiru'', which can be used on Google TV, Android TV, and Fire TV, allows you to keep public domain pictures on your TV. By displaying pictures on the TV all the time when it is not in use, the purpose is for children to get used to the culture of painting. read more...

items.title: スイス全土をマインクラフトで実物大に再現した「Blocks」が公開される、標高4634mの山頂や巨大氷河も探索可能
items.summary: スイスの国土全域をサンドボックスゲーム「Minecraft(マインクラフト)」の世界に再現したプロジェクト「Blocks」が公開されました。スイスの公式地理データを使って約4万1285平方キロメートルの国土を実物大で再現しており、アルプスの山々や氷河、湖、森林などをゲーム内で自由に探索できます。続きを読む...

zh.title: 《我的世界》中以实物大小再现整个瑞士的《Blocks》即将发布，还可以探索海拔 4,634 m 的山峰和巨大的冰川
zh.summary: 在沙盒游戏《我的世界》的世界中再现瑞士全境的“Blocks”项目已经发布。利用瑞士官方地理数据，以真实尺寸再现了该国约41,285平方公里的土地面积，你可以在游戏中自由探索阿尔卑斯山、冰川、湖泊、森林等。阅读更多...

en.title: ``Blocks'', a life-size reproduction of the whole of Switzerland in Minecraft, will be released, and you can also explore the mountain peak at an altitude of 4,634 m and a huge glacier
en.summary: The project ``Blocks'', which recreates the entire territory of Switzerland in the world of the sandbox game ``Minecraft'', has been released. Using Switzerland's official geographical data, the country's land area of ​​approximately 41,285 square kilometers has been recreated in real size, and you can freely explore the Alps, glaciers, lakes, forests, and more within the game. read more...

items.title: マンガの原稿を落とさないようにできる無料のスケジュール管理ソフト「Otosazu」、クリスタと連動してページ工程ごとに作業時間を計測・記録可能

zh.title: “Otosazu”是一款免费的日程管理软件，可以防止您丢失漫画原稿，可以与 Crysta 结合测量和记录每个页面处理的工作时间

en.title: "Otosazu", a free schedule management software that can prevent you from dropping manga manuscripts, can measure and record work time for each page process in conjunction with Crysta
en.summary: Game creator tozica has released "Otosazu", a schedule management software specialized for drawing manga. You can also record work hours in conjunction with CLIP STUDIO PAINT files, predict the expected completion date from the records, and create a schedule. read more...
